verdict.rationale: Digits documents an AI-native month-end close workflow that starts reconciliations before month-end, generates accrual and depreciation schedules, runs quality-control checks, and surfaces exceptions. Firm plans add task management and roles and permissions, and financials support collaborative review. However, nothing shows an explicit close checklist with per-item tracking or formal reviewer sign-offs; the product frames the close as automated rather than checklist-driven. Missing for 10: an explicit close checklist object, documented review/sign-off approval steps, per-item reconciliation/accrual status tracking, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
